## PLANKA Community 2.3.0

Board filters you can save, comment replies and `@mentions` in descriptions,
webhooks scoped to a project or an account, a keyboard shortcuts dialog — and a
set of hardening fixes. We recommend updating.

### Security

- **Sign-in limits**: failed attempts are now limited per client address and per account.
- **Two-factor**: a pending sign-in is destroyed after repeated wrong codes, and the second factor is also asked for after updated terms are accepted.
- **Protected files** (avatars, background images, favicons): the session, account status and password age are checked, not only the token signature, and each route serves only its own directory.
- **Link favicons**: the server no longer fetches from private, loopback or link-local addresses, including after redirects and at the moment of connecting.
- **Notifications and webhooks** return only the public profile of the creator.
- **`SECRET_KEY`**: PLANKA warns on every start while it is missing, too short, or still the example value. If you copied `notsecretkey` from the example compose file, change it.
- **Backups**: the example backup script encrypts the archive when `BACKUP_PASSPHRASE` is set.
- Client and build dependencies updated (`sanitize-html`, `svgo`, `js-yaml`, `fast-uri`).

### Added

- **Board filters**: filter by a set of lists, by unassigned cards, exclude labels (negative label filter), and save a filter under a name to pick up again later.
- **Comment replies**, and `@name` mentions in card descriptions.
- **Webhook scope**: fire a webhook for one project or one account instead of everything.
- **Apprise control**: `APPRISE_ENABLED`, `APPRISE_ALLOWED_SCHEMAS` and `APPRISE_BLOCKED_SCHEMAS` let operators decide which notification schemas an instance may use.
- **Keyboard shortcuts dialog** (user menu), plus `+` to add a card to the list under the pointer and `F` to jump to the filter search.
- **List view**: reorder cards by hand.
- **List card counter** on the add-card button, as a board setting.
- **Session memory**: boards reopen in the last view, lists at their last scroll position, and you return to the page you were on after signing in again.
- **Unsaved card descriptions** survive a browser crash and are offered back.
- Label picker as a grid of chips, tooltips on icon buttons.
- `DATABASE_URL__FILE` to read the whole connection string from a secret file.
- Helm chart: probe settings, `defaultBaseUrl`, Artifact Hub metadata.
- `db:clean-orphaned-records` and `client:locales:check` scripts.

### Changed

- Missing translations filled in for all 34 languages.
- Dependencies updated, including Apprise 1.11.0.

### Fixed

- Endless list pagination: no more errors on unreadable cursors, no skipped or repeated cards with an active filter.
- A card created while a filter is active no longer drops out of view.
- Helm chart: volumes are writable (`fsGroup`), ownership is taken once on first start, the base URL scheme follows the ingress TLS setting, the README installs from the chart repository.
- `db:` scripts read the database password and `__FILE` secrets the same way as the app.
- The container stops with a clear message when its uid cannot write the runtime directories.
- Blank home view when a membership points at a deleted project.
- Task reordering with hidden completed tasks, Enter during IME composition, Swedish date formats, validation messages on login and user settings, input validation in `db:create-admin-user`.

---

### What's in PLANKA Pro

The latest Pro release, **2.5.0**, brings a touch layout for phones and tablets,
five themes, a personal dashboard, cards on more than one board, timeline and
project-wide views, templates, PDF/HTML exports and live presence.
All Pro release notes are collected in #1755. More at
[planka.app/pro](https://planka.app/pro?ref=github-release) — you can
[try Pro for 30 days on your own server](https://planka.app/trial?ref=github-release).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/plankanban/planka/compare/v2.2.1...v2.3.0
